title: UMAS: System-Level Uncertainty Quantification for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33013v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) are a promising paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, yet they remain prone to hallucinations and erroneous outputs. Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is crucial for assessing system reliability, but existing methods are largely designed for single-agent settings; how to exploit MAS structure for UQ while keeping inference cost-neutral remains underexplored. We propose UMAS, a parameter-free, cost-neutral, system-level UQ framework that estimates the credibility of inter-agent influence from each generation's intrinsic confidence. UMAS uses these credibility signals to modulate how uncertainty is updated at each node, and then aggregates node-level uncertainty into a system-level estimate. Extensive evaluations on Debate and DyLAN across diverse benchmarks show that UMAS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by an average of 10.54 AUROC points. Beyond uncertain

translated_title: UMAS：面向多智能体大语言模型系统的系统级不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）是提升大语言模型推理能力的一种有前景的范式，但其仍然容易产生幻觉和错误输出。不确定性量化（UQ）对于评估系统可靠性至关重要，但现有方法大多针对单智能体场景设计；如何在保持推理成本不变的前提下，利用多智能体系统的结构来进行不确定性量化，仍缺乏充分研究。我们提出UMAS，这是一个无参数、成本中性的系统级不确定性量化框架，它从每次生成的内在置信度中估计智能体间影响力的可信度。UMAS利用这些可信度信号来调节每个节点上不确定性的更新方式，进而将节点级的不确定性聚合为系统级估计。在Debate和DyLAN框架上跨多个基准的广泛评估表明，UMAS持续优于最先进的基线方法，平均领先10.54个AUROC点。
tldr: UMAS是一个无参数、成本中性的系统级不确定性量化框架，它通过从生成结果的内在置信度估计智能体间影响力的可信度，并据此调节和聚合节点级不确定性，在多智能体大语言模型系统上平均领先最先进基线10.54个AUROC点。
en_tdlr: UMAS is a parameter-free, cost-neutral, system-level uncertainty quantification framework that estimates the credibility of inter-agent influence from each generation's intrinsic confidence to modulate and aggregate node-level uncertainty, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by an average of 10.54 AUROC points on multi-agent LLM systems.
